focused.description: Whether the new Agent Window should take focus. Omitted means the extension's default (`true`) for compatibility with older clients.

height.description: Optional Agent Window outer height in CSS pixels (100..=7680).

mode.description: Session target selection. The default keeps the isolated Agent Window behaviour; `current_tab` binds the last-focused window's active tab.

width.description: Optional Agent Window outer width in CSS pixels (100..=7680).
